target_pattern: Combine indirect and direct object pronouns with dar in preterite, using fixed order (IO -> DO -> verb) and mandatory le/les to se shift before lo/la/los/las.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Building gave it to her word-by-word with English pronoun order.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish uses a fixed pronoun sequence and transforms le/les to se before direct object pronouns.
target_pattern_formula: Optional clarifier remains possible: Se lo di a María

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Le di el libro a María. -> rewrite only with pronouns.
Base: Les dimos las llaves a ellos. -> rewrite only with pronouns.
Base: Te di el dinero. -> change direct object to plural (los boletos).
Base: Me diste la receta. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Se lo dio. -> change direct object to feminine singular.
Base: Se la dimos. -> change indirect recipient from third person to te.
Base: Nos lo dieron. -> change direct object to feminine plural.
Base: Te las di. -> make it a yes/no question.
Base: Se los diste. -> change tense person to yo preterite.
Base: Le dio el examen a los estudiantes. -> rewrite only pronouns.
Base: Me lo dio. -> make it negative.
Base: Se la di. -> add clarifier a Juan.
Base: Se los dieron. -> change direct object to singular masculine.
Base: Te los di. -> change indirect to nos.
Base: Nos lo dio. -> change verb to plural subject ellos.
